jobs.title: Physical Wellness Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
POSITION DESCRIPTION

**Position Title:** Physical Wellness Program Coordinator

**Status:** Full time, non-exempt

**Location:** Remote, preference for Texas residency

**Reports To:** Director of Physical Wellness and Sports and Recreation

**ATTENTION: Only applicants who submit a cover letter detailing why they are interested in Hope For The Warriors as well as explaining their connection to the military community will be considered . All applications MUST include: a resume, cover letter AND a complete list of any current nutrition, fitness, strength & conditioning, wellness certifications**. **Adaptive Sport Experience preferred. Please note responses must be original and written by the applicant. AI-generated submissions will not be reviewed.**

**This is an early career opportunity. Candidates with advanced degrees will also not be considered.**

**Background:**

Established in 2006, Hope For The Warriors® (Hope) is a civilian, 501(c)(3) non-profit organization. The mission of Hope For the Warriors® is to restore the quality of life for post-9/11 service members, their families, and families of the fallen who have sustained physical and psychological wounds in the line of duty. Hope For The Warriors® is dedicated to restoring a sense of self, restoring the family unit, and restoring hope for our service members and our military families.

**Core Values:**  
Hope For The Warriors® understands the challenges, pride, and joy of being a military family. For today, tomorrow, and years to come, we will strive to meet the changing needs of service members and their families. Additionally, we value community. Through our grassroots philosophy of interacting with the communities Veterans live and work in, we establish and nurture the relationships that have become the foundation of our support.

**Position Summary:**  
The Physical Wellness Program Coordinator engages members of the Warrior Community—veterans, transitioning service members, and their families—in activities that promote physical health and emotional well-being. The coordinator delivers direct support, facilitates goal setting, and manages participation in HOPE’s Physical Wellness Programs: Individual Athlete, Adaptive Equipment, and Team HOPE. This role supports clients through one-on-one communication, intake and goal assessments, motivational coaching, and event coordination. It also strengthens connections between physical activity and mental health, guiding clients toward improved quality of life. This is conducted within the scope of a holistic person-centered approach to well-being which is anchored within the delta of mind, body, and spirit.

**Primary Role:**

jobs.title: Operations Specialist III, Aerospace & Defense (US)
jobs.description:
### **Company Introduction:**

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that's redefining how the world's most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.

Airspace has been rated one of America's best Startup Employers and listed as one of CNBC's Disruptor 50 companies. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m.

The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics.

**Be the Team's Deepest Problem-Solver**
----------------------------------------

Every ops floor needs a small number of people who can be handed the hardest problem in the queue and trusted to get it right — balancing cost, speed, and customer impact without defaulting to escalation. As an Operations Specialist III, you're that person for your team.

You resolve what OS I and OS II can't, you help the team solve it themselves next time, and you understand the business well enough to make the close calls — which carrier, which cost, which tradeoff — that protect both service quality and margin. For the rare issue that needs to be fielded by someone supporting Ops leadership and account managers directly, you know when to bring in an Ops Expert.

  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

*Must be able to perform all responsibilities included in the Operations Specialist II job description, in addition to the following:*

### **Resolve the Hardest Escalations**

* Independently resolve all escalated issues using available resources with minimal to no assistance
* Assist in resolving team member escalations and questions
* Anticipate problems before they surface and act early

### **Make the Margin and Cost Tradeoffs**

* Understand margin versus total cost for an order and apply that knowledge to additional charge approvals
* Balance speed, cost, and customer impact when making big-picture decisions, without defaulting to escalation (e.g., choosing a carrier based on service reliability and error-rate history rather than the fastest or cheapest option alone)
* Maintain deep, practiced knowledge of the trade, regulatory, and compliance requirements relevant to your assigned sector

### **Set the Standard for the Team**

* Serve as the go-to resource on sector-specific process nuance and edge cases within the team
* Flag SOP gaps and suggest improvements to your supervisor based on frontline experience
* Uphold team expectations by leading through example
* Maintain any certifications required for your assigned sector and stay current on related compliance requirements; assist teammates with related questions

### **Maintain a Balanced Level of Performance**

As an OS III, you'll be expected to maintain minimal to no errors or service failures, make sound decisions under pressure, and meet the customer service standards appropriate for this level. Specific metrics vary by sector and will be communicated by your direct reporting supervisor.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

* Demonstrated success as an Operations Specialist II, or equivalent experience independently resolving complex, time-critical logistics escalations
* Working knowledge of margin and cost tradeoffs, and comfort applying that knowledge to real-time approval decisions
* Deep, near-expert familiarity with the trade, regulatory, and compliance requirements relevant to your sector
* Track record of coaching or supporting less-tenured teammates through difficult issues
* Sound judgment under pressure, with a track record of getting ahead of problems rather than reacting to them
* Willingness to obtain additional certifications, where applicable within your sector
* Available for 2 weeks of training in person on-site in our Carlsbad, CA headquarters

  

**Advancement to Ops Expert**
-----------------------------

Ops Expert is a step up in scope, not just tenure: it moves from executing within your sector to being the escalation point leadership and account managers turn to directly, with elevated coaching and live-operations responsibility. To advance, you'll need to demonstrate all of the following:

* Minimum of 9-12 months in the OS III role
* Consistently meeting or exceeding OS III performance standards, tracked through ongoing 1:1 check-ins and confirmed across two consecutive Semi-Annual Reviews (SARs)
* Demonstrated ability to guide teammates in real time — catching and correcting issues as they happen, not just after the fact
* Working familiarity with monitoring and resourcing tools (e.g., Zendesk, Twilio, live dashboards) beyond your own queue
* Willingness to obtain additional certifications required for the Expert tier, where applicable, in addition to your existing sector certifications
* Manager recommendation, confirming readiness to operate as the sector's top escalation resource and take on informal team-leadership responsibility

**Compensation**
----------------

* Hourly pay range: $26-30/hr
* High-quality health, vision, and dental care plan options
* 401K company contribution program
* Professional learning and training reimbursements

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Operations and Automation Manager  
Link 360 | Remote (US) | Full time  
$60,000-$70,000 base, $85,000-$95,000 target total comp

We run outbound revenue programs for our clients. A client signs, and thirty days later they have a working team including the technology that helps it run: a CRM built out, email and LinkedIn campaigns live, a dedicated Sales Development Rep on the phones, and meetings landing on their calendar.

Right now about sixty separate tasks stand between the signature and the launch, and all of them are manual. We're hiring the person who takes that over and then makes most of it run without a person touching it. – Not to replace you, to streamline what you have to do so you can focus on critical human operational activities.

That second part is the actual job. If you've built AI agents and automations that do real work unattended, you'd be designing the automation layer for this entire company from scratch. No legacy system to work around, no committee, direct line to the founder. Build it well and the job gets smaller every quarter, you.. get more focused on the most valuable activities we can’t or don’t want to automate with Ai. Which is exactly what we're paying for.

**What you'd do**

Build the client systems. GoHighLevel sub-accounts, pipelines, calendars, forms, workflows. Sending domains and DNS, mailbox warmup, A2P registration, dialer setup, CRM integrations. If a workflow breaks at 7am you're the one who knows why.

Automate the onboarding. Take the sixty-task launch checklist and cut it down. Agents, automations, templates, whatever works. We'll set a baseline in your first week and part of your bonus is paid on how far you move it.

Produce the campaigns. Each client segment needs an email sequence, a LinkedIn sequence, an SDR call guide, a one-page document, and a landing page. You'll use AI to produce them and edit until they don't read like AI wrote them.

Approve the data. Our data team builds the lists. You check them, filter them, scrub them, and decide what gets imported. A bad list wastes a month of calling.

Run SDR coaching. Weekly call recording reviews, written feedback, role plays, and updates to the call guide based on what you hear. You run the routine and improve it.

Document everything. You're the first person in this seat. What you build becomes the training system for everyone after you.

**What we need you to already have**

You've built AI agents or multi-step automations that run on their own and do real operational work. Content, enrichment, reporting, QA, handoffs between systems. This one isn't negotiable and we'll ask you to walk us through what you built.

Two to four years in marketing ops, revenue ops, sales ops, or agency account management, with your hands in the tools rather than overseeing someone else's.

You've built inside a CRM and marketing automation platform. GoHighLevel is a big plus. Serious build work in HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Keap, or Salesforce counts if you pick up platforms fast.

You understand cold email infrastructure. SPF, DKIM, DMARC, warmup, deliverability troubleshooting.

You write well. Some of what you produce goes out under a client's name.

You're organized past the point other people find reasonable. Checklists, documentation, follow-through. Our launch dates are contractual and about sixty things have to happen in thirty days to hit one.

**What we offer**

$60,000 to $70,000 base depending on experience and location, with the top of the range for someone who already has both the AI build background and the operations background. Performance pay on top, paid on task completion and on-time launches, automation you build that measurably cuts manual work, on-time client deliverables, and client retention. Target total is $85,000 to $95,000 in year one and grows past six figures as the client portfolio grows.

Fully remote. We're based in Phoenix and work nationally. Some overlap with Mountain Time required.

Real ownership, which at our size means something. You'll be building the system this company runs on instead of maintaining someone else's.

**How to apply**

Send a resume and a short note covering two things: an automation or agent you built that's still running, and the messiest process you've ever cleaned up. We read these. A generic cover letter tells us nothing.

Pay: $85,000.00 - $95,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience building Ai automation and/or Ai Employees?
* Do you have experience improving operations and service delivery for a company inside a business services industry?

Work Location: Remote

Billing Operations Manager  
  
GridSource is seeking a Billing Operations Manager to lead the billing analyst team within our Managed Services Division. This role owns the accuracy and timeliness of billing across multiple markets and service lines — FTTx fiber installation, Multi-Dwelling Unit (MDU), and Buried Service Wire (BSW) work — and is responsible for the people, processes, and controls that turn completed field work into correct, on-time invoices. You will lead a team of analysts, coordinate the inputs that drive each billing cycle, and build the process improvements that keep billing clean as the business grows.  
  
What You'll Do  
The Billing Operations Manager sits at the center of how GridSource gets paid. You will manage and develop a team of billing analysts, hold the line on billing accuracy, and keep multiple concurrent work streams moving so that every market bills on time. Just as important, you will improve how the work gets done — strengthening controls, closing gaps, and building repeatable processes — and report clearly and concisely to the EVP and senior leadership on billing status, risks, and results. Success means invoices that are correct the first time, billing cycles that close on schedule, and a team that gets steadily better at both.  

*Team Leadership & Development*

* Lead, develop, and manage the performance of a team of billing analysts working across markets.
* Set clear standards for accuracy, turnaround, and follow-through, and hold the team to them.
* Balance and assign workload so billing deadlines are met without single points of failure.

*Billing Accuracy & Controls*

* Own the accuracy, completeness, and auditability of invoices across FTTx, MDU, and BSW work in multiple markets.
* Reconcile completed field work to billed amounts, and identify and resolve discrepancies before invoices go out.
* Establish and maintain the controls that prevent revenue leakage, missed billing, and avoidable customer disputes.

*Multi-Workstream Coordination & On-Time Delivery*

* Coordinate the inputs that drive each billing cycle — field production data, project records, and rate/contract terms — across teams and markets.
* Keep concurrent billing work streams on schedule so each market closes on time.
* Flag and clear the bottlenecks that threaten a billing deadline.

*Process Improvement & Systems*

* Analyze the current billing process end to end and build improvements that raise both accuracy and speed.
* Design repeatable, documented workflows and controls that scale as markets and volume grow.
* Partner with operations, finance, and systems teams to improve the tools and data behind billing.

*Reporting & Executive Communication*

* Provide succinct, numbers-first reporting on billing status, risks, and results to the EVP and C-suite.
* Surface issues early with a recommended course of action, not just a problem.
* Translate billing detail into the few metrics leadership needs to make decisions.

What You'll Need  

*Core Competencies (Required)*

* Team leadership — a proven ability to lead, develop, and get results from a team.
* Billing accuracy & controls — a track record of owning correct, auditable, on-time billing and the controls behind it.
* Multi-workstream coordination — able to keep several concurrent billing streams and deadlines on track across markets.
* Process improvement & systems thinking — sees how the whole process fits together and builds durable improvements, with a continuous-improvement mindset.
* Executive communication — succinct, numbers-first communication to EVP and C-suite audiences.

*Experience & Logistics*

* Prior experience leading or supervising a team (required).
* Working knowledge of billing for FTTx fiber installation, MDU, and BSW work in a multi-market environment.
* Comfort working across billing/ERP systems and spreadsheets, with strong attention to detail.
* Remote role; must be available during core business hours of 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Central Time.
* Less than 10% travel.

*Preferred Qualifications*

* Experience in telecommunications, broadband, or construction / field-services billing.
* Experience building or overhauling a billing process, not just running one.
* Familiarity with job-costing, rate/contract structures, and production-based billing.
* Experience billing for major carriers or MSOs.
* Familiarity with billing-system implementations or reporting / BI tools.

*Work Environment*

* Fully remote, with required availability during 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Central Time.
* Less than 10% travel.
* Close coordination with the EVP, operations and project teams, and finance across multiple markets.

What We Offer

* Health, vision, and dental insurance
* Paid time off (PTO)
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Paid sick leave in accordance with applicable state and local laws

Why Work For GridSource?  
GridSource is a full-service utility contractor specializing in telecommunications and broadband construction, as well as underground construction for the natural gas distribution industry.

XO Health is the first health plan designed by and for self-insured employers that delivers a more unified health experience for everyone – from those who receive care, to those who deliver it, to those who pay for it.

We are growing a multi-disciplinary team of diverse and digitally empowered employees ready to rebuild trust in healthcare through comprehensive and unified transformation.

**ABOUT XO HEALTH:**

XO Health is a technology-driven health plan built for self-insured employers. We serve employers, members, and providers through a value-based care network, a risk contracting engine, and a real-time data and analytics platform. We are a small, fast-moving team where every person owns outcomes, not just tasks.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

The Implementation Lead owns the end-to-end onboarding of new employer groups and TPA partners, from signed agreement through effective date and a stable first 60 days. You are the single point of accountability for a clean, on-time go-live: the plan is built correctly, eligibility flows, ID cards and welcome kits land, the member app is configured, and the client knows exactly where things stand at every step.

This is a hands-on, build-the-playbook role. You will run implementations yourself while standardizing how XO does them, so that each one is faster and cleaner than the last. You will work across Commercial, Plan Operations, Claims, Network, IT, and Compliance, and you will be the person clients, brokers, and TPAs trust to get them live.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Client and TPA Onboarding:**

* Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new employer groups and TPA partners, from kickoff through effective date and post-go-live stabilization.
* Build and maintain the implementation plan for each client: benefit design and plan documents, group structure, eligibility and enrollment setup, stop-loss coordination, vendor and partner integrations, member communications, and compliance requirements.
* Own the accurate setup of each group across XO's systems and partner platforms, including benefit configuration, eligibility file testing, ID card and welcome kit production, member app configuration, and any SSO or portal integrations.
* Translate client-specific requirements into clear instructions for internal teams and confirm they are executed correctly before go-live.

**Project Management:**

* Run the cross-functional implementation team and ensure critical milestones are completed. Surface risks early, resolve blockers, and escalate with a recommendation when needed.
* Coordinate with Claims, Plan Operations, Network, IT, Compliance, and Finance to ensure ownership is properly assigned and dates are adhered to .
* Maintain a regular reporting cadence with leadership and flag anything that puts a go-live at risk.

**Client Communication:**

* Serve as the primary contact for the client, broker, and TPA throughout implementation. Lead recurring status meetings and keep a clear record of open items and decisions.
* Prepare client-facing implementation documentation, checklists, and readiness sign-offs.
* Hand off cleanly to the ongoing account owner at the end of the stabilization period, with full documentation of the group's setup and any open items.

**Playbook and Continuous Improvement:**

* Own XO's implementation playbook: standard timelines, checklists, templates, and data requirements for employer and TPA onboarding.
* Identify manual steps and failure points in the process and work with Operations and Product to automate or remove them.
* Turn lessons from each implementation into playbook improvements that strengthen the process and enable scale ahead of growth.

**EXPERIENCE and EDUCATION:**

**Required:**

* 5+ years in implementation, client onboarding, or project management within self-funded health benefits, TPA operations, or a health plan.
* Working knowledge of self-funded medical and pharmacy plan design, and the compliance landscape that comes with it (ERISA, ACA, CAA, Mental Health Parity).
* Direct experience running complex, multi-party healthcare implementations on a fixed effective date.
* Fluency in the employer and TPA distribution channel, including how brokers, consultants, benefits administrators, and stop-loss carriers fit together.
* Comfort with eligibility files, enrollment data, and system configuration. You do not need to be technical, but you need to be precise and unafraid of the details.
* Clear, concise communicator who can confidently lead client discussions and provide leadership with direct, well-informed answers.
* Strong organizational skills and the judgment to prioritize when everything feels urgent.

**Preferred**:

* Experience implementing on behalf of, or alongside, a TPA.
* Experience at an early-stage or high-growth company where you built the process rather than inherited it.
* Familiarity with health plan technology platforms, member apps, or provider directory tools.
* PMP or similar project management credentials.

**KEY PERSONAL AND PROFESSIONAL ATTRIBUTES:**

***Accountability:*** you own the outcome and say so when something is off track.

***Critical Thinking:*** you solve problems from first principles and learn what the organization needs next.

***Change Champion:*** you are committed to building and comfortable when the plan changes.

***Relationships:***you build trust quickly with clients, partners, and colleagues.

The Illinois Regional Care Coordination Agency (RCCA) administers and manages sub-awards related to opioid settlement funds, supports related public-facing websites, and helps coordinate regional opioid response efforts in Illinois. The RCCA supports equitable implementation of state resources for communities affected by the opioid crisis.

The Senior Program Manager I will lead an assigned portfolio of subrecipient programs. This role is accountable for performance monitoring, deliverable accountability, compliance, complex relationship management, and sound program decisions. The position requires the ability to coordinate work across teams through influence rather than supervisory authority.

The role requires independent judgment. The ideal candidate can interpret governing authorities, assess risk, monitor performance and fiscal compliance, resolve issues within delegated authority, and escalate matters that exceed that authority. They also bring experience with procurement, stakeholder coordination, competing priorities, and program monitoring.

This is a remote position based in Illinois. The position requires travel throughout the state and to AHP's Chicago Office for meetings and training.

**Knowledge**

**Grant Compliance and Funding Administration:**

* Working knowledge of federal grants management under 2 CFR Part 200 and Illinois grants administration under GATA, including the ability to apply requirements in practical situations.

* Review performance and spending data across multiple subrecipients to distinguish one-time issues, trends and needed follow-up from broader program problems.

jobs.title: Enterprise Systems Program Manager

***Job Summary***
-----------------

The Enterprise Systems Program Manager serves as a lead within Digital, Technology & Transformation (DTT), responsible for a portfolio of enterprise systems initiatives and strategic technology programs, with a focus on financial and HR applications, that support organizational objectives across multiple business functions. Oversees the planning, execution, governance, and successful delivery of concurrent projects spanning enterprise applications, business processes, systems integrations, data, and digital transformation initiatives. Partners with cross-functional stakeholders, DTT leaders, business leaders, vendors, and executive sponsors to align technology investments with organizational priorities. Manages program-level risks, dependencies, budgets, and resources across multiple concurrent initiatives while guiding stakeholders through the full lifecycle of enterprise systems investments.

***Accountabilities:***

* Manage a portfolio: Oversee enterprise systems initiatives and concurrent projects, maintaining roadmaps, plans, schedules, budgets, forecasts, and performance metrics across the full lifecycle — from business case through implementation, adoption, and operational transition.
* Engage stakeholders: partner with business leaders, stakeholders, and technical teams to identify opportunities, define requirements, and prioritize initiatives; facilitate cross-functional discussions to build consensus on priorities, solutions, and implementation plans.
* Serve as liaison: act as the primary point of contact between business stakeholders, DTT, and technical subject matter experts, ensuring business needs are clearly represented and communicated.
* Track and control delivery: monitor status, budgets, resources, risks, dependencies, and issues, applying corrective actions to keep initiatives on track.
* Ensure governance and compliance: align initiatives with organizational priorities, governance processes, enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, and established methodologies.
* Manage vendors: oversee vendor relationships, contracts, and external service providers to support program outcomes.
* Maintain documentation: establish and maintain project/program documentation, reporting, schedules, forecasts, and communication plans.
* Drive improvement: promote continuous improvement in systems, processes, and program management practices, while fostering collaboration, transparency, and accountability across teams and leadership.

***Applied Knowledge & Skills:***

* Strong leadership, facilitation, and communication skills, with a proven ability to guide diverse stakeholder groups through complex decision-making toward consensus.
* Expertise in program, portfolio, and governance management, strategic planning, and organizational change management, including stakeholder engagement.
* Skilled in partnering with stakeholders to drive enterprise systems strategy, business process improvement, and systems lifecycle management (ERP, financial management, grants management, human capital management, and enterprise reporting).
* Advanced knowledge of project/program/portfolio management methodologies, with the ability to translate complex technical and business information into actionable recommendations for executive leadership.

***Problem Solving & Impact:***

* Facilitates business and technology decision-making across cross-functional stakeholder groups, driving alignment by identifying dependencies, risks, trade-offs, and impacts across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Analyzes complex business, process, and system challenges to recommend practical solutions aligned with organizational goals, resources, and operational needs, presenting options to leadership to support decisions on scope, schedule, resources, and investments.
* Exercises independent judgment to manage program risks, resolve issues, and recommend corrective actions, balancing strategic objectives with operational realities to ensure successful delivery of enterprise systems programs.
* Works independently, with limited supervision, managing a portfolio of initiatives across multiple departments, and contributes to improvements in governance, project delivery, stakeholder engagement, and business processes through project management best practices.

***Supervision Given/Received:***

* Oversees quality and successful delivery of assigned programs, resolving issues among project teams and stakeholders and recommending solutions to management as needed.
* Monitors program and project budgets, and manages and coordinates resources across a matrixed organization, including business stakeholders, technical teams, and external partners.
* Manages contractor and vendor relationships, deliverables, and performance, and participates in resource planning and allocation to support organizational priorities.
* Provides teams with direction, feedback, and recognition, enabling cross-functional collaboration and knowledge sharing across stakeholder groups.

jobs.title: D365 Project Manager, Managed Services
jobs.description:
**Location** Virtual, home based office with travel

**Description**

The MCA Connect Project Manager in this role carries a blended portfolio. You will manage day to day support for live Dynamics 365 clients under Managed Services (MgS), manage the discrete enhancement and new functionality work those same clients buy, and direct one or more full life-cycle Dynamics 365 implementations from diagnosis through go-live and transition into support.

  

These three types of work are genuinely different disciplines.

* MgS live support is a queue to be managed against service commitments.
* New functionality and enhancement work is a series of small, fixed-scope projects that must be estimated, scheduled and billed without disturbing the support commitment.
* A full life-cycle implementation is a large, multi-phase program with its own team, budget and executive visibility.

  

The person in this role must be able to manage all three at once, switch cleanly between them, and protect each from the others.

  

You will be supported by a strong delivery team of solution architects, functional and technical consultants, and developers, but you will need a strong background in project management and business process optimization, and either a solid working knowledge of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 platform or the capacity to build one quickly. Our projects are strategic investments for our clients. Their successful execution and their ongoing support both require a project manager who is driven, proactive, creative, assertive and relationship oriented.

  

While your primary function is project management, from time to time you may also be asked to assist with other functions including sales and marketing, implementation-related tasks, and general administration.

### **Responsibilities**

The responsibilities below are grouped into the disciplines common to every engagement, then the three work streams in turn, then the financial, communication and practice duties that run across all of them. Each group opens with what the work is and why it matters, followed by the specific tasks the role owns.

**Core project management, all work streams**
---------------------------------------------

A set of project management disciplines applies to every engagement you carry, whatever its size or commercial shape.

* Manage multiple concurrent client engagements, and own deliverables, scope and expectations on each of them.
* Provide leadership to all functional and business areas affected by the work.
* Develop and maintain project plans, cost estimates, resource plans, communication plans, risk mitigation plans and issue resolution plans.
* Drive project decisions and make recommendations to management about schedules, prioritization and resource allocation.
* Work with MCA Connect resource management to secure resources, and resolve the challenges between support needs, enhancement commitments and other milestones.
* Employ project management leading practices as provided by PMI and MCA Connect delivery standards.
* Drive client satisfaction across the portfolio and own the health relationship of every account you carry.

**MgS live support clients**
----------------------------

For an assigned portfolio of live Dynamics 365 clients, the work is a managed queue rather than a plan: tickets arrive on their own schedule to a support queue, and your job is to see that they are triaged correctly, worked by the right consultant, resolved inside the contracted commitment, and visible to the client throughout. Alongside the queue you monitor consumption against contract in period and raise the conversation about overage or change before the period closes rather than after.

* Own the service relationship for each assigned live client and act as their main point of accountability.
* Manage the client’s service desk tickets: triage, prioritization, assignment, aging, escalation and closure.
* Balance case load across the available consultant pool and keep the queue from concentrating on one person.
* Run regular service reviews covering ticket volumes and trends, consumption against the retainer or hours block, open risks and the forward plan.
* Manage environment optimization and management activities, including release and update readiness for Microsoft's service update cadence, environment refreshes and performance reviews.
* Monitor consumption against contract in period and flag over-consumption and under-consumption early.
* Drive the conversation about overage, carry-over or contract change before the period closes.
* Convert recurring incidents and chronic pain points into problem records, root cause work or scoped enhancement proposals.
* Maintain accurate case records, time capture and status in Symphony so reporting, invoicing and utilization figures reconcile without manual correction.
* Receive projects transitioning in from the implementation team and confirm documentation, environments, known issues and open items all transferred.

**New functionality and enhancement delivery**
----------------------------------------------

Live clients regularly buy work that is not support. Further work could be a customization, implement a new D365 module, an integration change, a business process review, or a training package. Each of these is a small project in its own right. The recurring tension in this stream is resource: enhancement work and the support queue draw on the same consultants, and you are expected to schedule around that rather than let one quietly starve the other.

* Qualify incoming requests, distinguish enhancements from support incidents, and route each to the right resources.
* Coordinate estimation with solution architects and consultants, and produce the scope, effort, schedule and price the client will approve.
* Secure written client approval of scope, cost and schedule before work begins.
* Schedule enhancement work packages against the same resource pool that carries the support

VirtForce Strategic Partner is seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Customer Support & QA Specialist to support a growing SaaS company serving commercial real estate professionals.

You will own customer support tickets from intake through resolution, troubleshoot platform questions, document findings, and help customers confidently navigate the software. **About Bitfocus**
------------------

At Bitfocus, our mission is simple but ambitious: help end homelessness. We do that by building and supporting Clarity Human Services, the technology that powers communities across the country in their work to connect people experiencing homelessness with the resources they need.

We're a team that leads with care, innovates with insider knowledge, and believes deeply in the power of community. We take pride in what we build, support one another through hard problems, and embrace smart risks in service of meaningful impact.

If you're someone who wants your work to matter and wants to grow alongside a team that's genuinely committed to getting this right, we'd love to have you.

We know strong candidates don't always look the same on paper. If you're excited about this role and believe you have what it takes, we'd love to hear from you; we're building a team that reflects the communities we serve.

**About the role**
------------------

As Customer Success Manager, you'll lead a team of three Account Managers, owning team performance, customer lifecycle management, and the delivery of exceptional service across our customer base. Central to this role is building deep, strategic relationships with customers; positioning Bitfocus not merely as an HMIS vendor, but as a trusted partner in advancing their mission to address homelessness. You'll play a key role in elevating Bitfocus's reputation and influence in the field by making sure customers are supported, successful, and engaged as long-term partners. -----------------------------------

Customer Success is responsible for ensuring Bitfocus customers are supported, successful, and engaged as long-term partners throughout their entire lifecycle with us. We work closely with Growth, Professional Services, and Product to keep every customer touchpoint cohesive.

**You'll know you're succeeding when...**

* Your team's retention rate is strong, and account health issues get caught and addressed before they become churn.

* **A partner mindset.** You see customer relationships as strategic, not transactional, and you build trust accordingly.
* **Data fluency.** You use account health data to drive decisions and prioritize outreach, not just to report on what already happened.
* **Cross-functional comfort.** You collaborate naturally with Growth, Product, and Professional Services toward shared outcomes.
* **Independent judgment.** You identify problems and build solutions with minimal direction.

Cyberhaven is looking for a Technical Account Manager to be the technical quarterback for our customers. jobs.description:
About Us:

**VOALA**

***Helping Our Most Vulnerable Change Their Life Stories***

Volunteers of America is a non-profit human services organization committed to serving people in need, strengthening families, and building communities. VOALA provides a variety of social services to Los Angeles area communities such as Head Start programs, Upward Bound college prep programs, veterans’ services, homeless shelters, low-income housing program as well as drug and alcohol rehabilitation. Learn more at www.voala.org.

**PAY RATE:** $24.99 - $26.30 Per Hour

**BENEFITS:** VOALA offers competitive medical, dental, vision and retirement benefits.

**JOB SUMMARY AND PURPOSE**

The Care Manager (Generalist) provides intensive care to program participants who have been, or are currently, involved with criminal justice system as well as suffering from co-occurring disorders, meeting participants at least weekly. The Care Manager is the primary point of contact to coordinate services and care for assigned clients. This position provides clients with the highest levels of acuity and co-morbidities individualized care through access to service linkages, counseling, treatment planning, and various crisis intervention methods in order to prepare individuals for further success

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Conducts comprehensive screenings and assessments with individuals (or families) to collect functional, environmental, psycho-social, financial, employment, housing, educational, and health information, as appropriate, to develop a detailed plan to meet the high acuity needs, sets goals for the clients, and locates the resources needed to meet the goals.
* Provide service linkages and support systems to ensure identified needs are met.
* Coordinates individualized planning and follow-up with clients to meet short and long-term needs, tracks progress on meeting agreed upon goals.
* Conducts regular meetings with clients; consults with service team regarding progress of cases; records all services provided and case notes, maintaining confidentiality of client’s data in accordance with HIPAA and other relevant funder, local or state regulations.
* Facilitates support groups, and group education events.
* Appears in court or other government agencies as advocate for clients relating to re-entry into society
* Other duties as may be assigned by Program Manager

**ESSENTIAL ABILITY ACKNOWLEDGEMENT**

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES:**

* Services for this position must be provided on-site. As a result, the position requires incumbents to report to work on-site each day of active employment.
* Assessment: through individual meetings on a regular basis develop a detailed plan of action to meet client needs, set goals and find the necessary resources to meet those goals
* Ongoing meetings with clients, tracking progress, continuously evaluating client needs
* Coordinate Care with other service providers, connecting participants to appropriate services
* Advocacy for clients in court and before other agencies/community settings
* Facilitates Group support sessions and group education sessions for program participants
* Maintains hard copy records and electronic files of all services provided to clients, following HIPAA and other related regulations
* Other duties as required and may be subject to change

**MANDATED REPORTER**

As service providers to the underprivileged and vulnerable in our community, all employees are considered Mandated Reporters, and must report any instance of physical or sexual abuse to proper authorities.

Qualifications

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Must be able to pass a fingerprint clearance, background check, including criminal history, personal references, employment and education verifications
* Must be able to pass Los Angeles Sherriff Department (LASD) background check
* Valid California driver's license and have reliable transportation
* Approval from Department of Health Services (DHS)
* TB Test
* Ability to perform under circumstances of possible emotional stress and conflicts dealing with difficult, uncooperative, and potentially aggressive clients as VOALA serves the neediest of the needy in our programs which may include clients with homelessness, mental-illness, substance abuse, recently released from incarceration and other challenges.

**EDUCATION:**

* Bachelor’s Degree (Social Work or related)
* Or A combination of education and relevant experience (4 years)

**EXPERIENCE:**

* At least 1-year case management experience (in addition to the education requirement – a total of 5 years education and experience) in homelessness, addictions, under-served, and/or prison re-entry program care – high acuity clients with co-morbidities

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 2 years of experience working with target population
* Familiar with HMIS, electronic record-keeping

The National Safety Council is America’s leading nonprofit safety advocate. We focus on eliminating the leading causes of preventable injuries and deaths. Through leadership, research, education, and advocacy, NSC focuses on areas where most unintentional injuries and deaths occur.
  
  
We are currently looking for a **Learning & Development Graphic Designer** to join us in our mission to save lives and prevent injuries.

The Learning & Development Graphic Designer is responsible for developing visually compelling, instructionally aligned designs that support high-quality learning experiences across multiple training modalities. This role plays a key part in establishing and maintaining a consistent visual identity for all NSC training products, including digital learning, instructor-led materials, print publications, and other learner-facing assets.

The ideal candidate brings strong visual design expertise, experience with eLearning environments, and the ability to translate complex concepts into clear, engaging graphics that enhance the learner experience.

* Create professional layouts and graphics for print deliverables such as participant guides, job aids, infographics, workbooks, and other training publications.
* Experience in preparing files for print, determining print specifications and conducting press checks.
* Transform complex information into learner-friendly, accessible visual formats.

**Brand Consistency & Standards**

* Ensure consistency in the look and feel of all NSC training products across digital and print mediums.

Full-Time | Remote (US) | Monday to Friday, 9 to 6 Eastern (6 to 3 Pacific) | $18 to $22 per hour

Insurance agents count on their CRM to follow up with leads and book appointments. When something breaks or they need help, you're who they reach. You'll be the person who gets new agents set up the right way, fixes what's wrong fast, and makes customers feel taken care of.

This role is for someone who loves customer support, writes and speaks clearly, and doesn't let a ticket sit.

**What You'll Do**

Run onboarding Zoom calls with new agents

Set up new agent accounts inside the CRM

Register business phone numbers so agents can text their leads (A2P texting registration)

Work the support ticket queue

Run support Zoom calls with agents who need help

Answer support emails

Fix and correct account problems

**What You Need**

2+ years in customer support, customer success, or account management

Excellent written and spoken communication

A calm, professional manner, even with a frustrated customer

Comfort learning new software quickly

Strong attention to detail. Small mistakes in account setup cause big problems later.

Available **Monday** to **Friday**, **9 AM to 5 PM Eastern**

Reliable high-speed internet, a computer, and a webcam for Zoom calls

**What Makes You Stand Out**

Experience with **GoHighLevel** (HighLevel) or a similar CRM

Experience in the **life or health insurance industry**

Experience with **Meta (Facebook) Ads Manager**

Experience supporting software customers

None of these are required.

**Pay, Schedule, and Benefits**

$18 to $22 per hour, based on experience

Full-time, direct hire. You'll be a W-2 employee of the company, not a contractor or temp.

Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern (1 hour unpaid lunch)

100% remote within the United States

Paid time off

Paid holidays

**How to Apply**

Apply on Indeed and answer the screening questions. One of them asks you to write a short reply to a customer. Take your time on it. It's the first thing the hiring team reads.

Pay: $18.00 - $22.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Paid training
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* This role works 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern (6 AM to 3 PM Pacific), Monday to Friday. Can you work those hours every week?
* Do you have reliable high-speed internet and a computer you can use for work? (Yes or No)
* Do you have a webcam and a quiet place to take Zoom calls? (Yes or No)
* Have you used GoHighLevel (HighLevel)? (Yes or No)
* Have you worked in the life or health insurance industry? (Yes or No)
* Have you used Meta (Facebook) Ads Manager? (Yes or No)
* An insurance agent sends this support ticket:

"I've been waiting TWO DAYS and my texts still aren't going out. I'm paying for this and losing leads every day. Fix it or I'm canceling."

Write your reply to this agent in 3 to 5 sentences. You don't know our software yet. We're grading how you'd talk to this customer, not the technical fix.

Experience:

* Customer support, customer success, or account management: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

* Participate in process-improvement initiatives designed to improve program efficiency and physician experience.

  

**Minimum Requirements**

**Experience:**

* Three or more years of progressively responsible administrative, healthcare operations, physician practice, medical staff, or program coordination experience.

**Preferred:**

new_jobs.description:
**Why Socure?**
---------------

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

**About the Role**
------------------

Product Operations exists to give product teams the systems, data, and processes they need to plan, prioritize, and deliver well — the same way Sales Ops supports Sales or DevOps supports Engineering. This role sits at the center of that discipline, contributing to three core areas: the **reporting and analytics** that give everyone visibility into what's happening, the **process** that makes planning and delivery repeatable instead of reinvented pod by pod, and the ongoing work of keeping **strategy and execution connected** as priorities shift.

We run Product Operations as a **hybrid centralized/embedded model**: some Product Ops work sits centrally and serves every product team consistently, while other Product Ops work sits embedded inside individual product lines, close to their day-to-day priorities. This role sits in the centralized hub — you're the shared systems, process, and reporting engine that every embedded product manager and product ops partner relies on, rather than being dedicated to any single product line.

We're a small team, so this role is intentionally broad. At larger companies, "owns the tools," "owns the reporting," and "owns the process" are sometimes split into two or three separate roles. Here, one person does all of it, with the flexibility to shift emphasis as priorities and team size change over time.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Support reporting & analytics for the Product Org**

* Build and maintain the dashboards and reports that give leadership and embedded product teams a reliable view of roadmap status, delivery progress, and portfolio health.
* Define and track core product operations metrics (e.g., cycle time, roadmap adherence, planning hygiene, tool adoption).
* Centralize and facilitate Product Performance metrics definition, telemetry builds, and availability to central data and BI teams, and coordinate dashboard and reporting builds with the central Business Intelligence team to enable deeper insights and faster decision making for the Product Team.
* Partner with Finance, Sales/RevOps, and Engineering to bring commercial and delivery data (e.g., CRM/ARR data) into product prioritization and reporting.
* Support recurring reporting cadences — business reviews, quarterly/annual planning, board updates — with clean, trusted data.
* Monitor data quality and drive hygiene standards across the systems that feed reporting.

### **Drive process, efficiency & team enablement**

* Design and document repeatable processes for planning, prioritization, intake, and roadmap reviews — so teams have a consistent way of working instead of reinventing it pod by pod.
* Identify friction points and manual, duplicative work in the product development lifecycle, and fix them — through better process, automation, or tooling.
* Build templates, playbooks, and checklists (e.g., for feature intake, roadmap reviews, launch readiness) that save product managers time and reduce administrative burden.
* Act as the go-to resource for product managers and embedded product ops partners on how to use shared tools and processes effectively — training, office hours, documentation.
* Facilitate cross-functional handoffs between Product, Engineering, Design, and GTM so work moves smoothly instead of stalling on a handoff.
* Continuously look for opportunities to standardize process across pods while leaving room for the flexibility each team actually needs.

### **Keep strategy and execution aligned**

* Partner with product leadership to translate high-level strategy and company priorities into a concrete, trackable roadmap and planning cadence.
* Run the rhythm of planning — quarterly/annual planning cycles, roadmap reviews, and business reviews — that keeps execution connected to strategy as priorities shift.
* Monitor progress against strategic priorities and flag early when day-to-day execution is drifting from what leadership actually intended.
* Support trade-off and prioritization conversations when competing asks conflict with stated strategic priorities, so decisions get made deliberately rather than by default.
* Make sure work happening inside individual pods visibly ladders up to company-level strategic themes, not just local priorities.
* Close the loop after major planning moments — make sure decisions made in a review actually get reflected in the systems everyone works from day to day.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Product teams and Leadership trust the systems and data they're working from.
* Leadership can get a reliable answer about roadmap and delivery status without a scramble.
* Tooling stays consistent and well-governed instead of fragmenting pod by pod.
* Planning cycles run on schedule, supported by clean data rather than last-minute reconciliation.
* Teams spend less time on manual coordination and administrative busywork, and more time making strategic decisions.
* Roadmap execution visibly ladders up to strategic priorities — and when it drifts, that gets caught and surfaced early, not discovered at quarter-end.
* Cross-functional handoffs happen through defined, repeatable processes instead of ad hoc effort every time.
* System and reporting knowledge is documented and shared, not held by one

FORMA was founded with a clear Mission: to be **the most respected partner for highly complex and detailed residential projects.**

You will lead sophisticated custom residential projects involving exceptional architecture, demanding details, discerning clients, and some of the best architects, designers, and craftspeople in the industry.

You keep supplies, kitchen stock, and shipping and receiving running without a hitch, and make sure the physical workplace never becomes a distraction from the work people are here to do.

**Safety, Security & Facilities Operations.** You're the first line of defense for a safe, functional workplace: overseeing building maintenance and repairs, managing badge access and visitor security, and staying ahead of health and safety compliance and emergency preparedness. When something breaks, or something's off, you're the one who notices first and gets it fixed.

You own event planning and execution for our headquarters, handle badge and desk setup for every new hire and contractor, keep the seating chart current as the team changes, and make sure every guest feels welcomed from the moment they arrive.

**Executive Operations.** You're a trusted extension of our G&A team: reconciling expenses with zero loose ends, booking travel well ahead of time, and managing executive visits proactively so nothing is left to chance. new_jobs.description:
Job Overview  
Patient Case Manager - healthcare startup

San Francisco, CA | Hybrid

$100,000-$130,000 a year

Full-time

About the role

We are recruiting Patient Case Managers for an early-stage, venture-backed healthcare startup developing personalized cancer vaccines. You'll be a steady point of contact for patients and families facing difficult decisions, helping them move through a complex treatment journey with care, clarity and follow-through.

This role is for candidates already based in the San Francisco Bay Area. Expect about four office days a week at the start. There is no relocation support.

What you'll own

- Guide patients, families and physicians from first enquiry through eligibility review, treatment preparation, dosing and follow-up.

- Keep records, consent paperwork, appointments and case timelines moving without missed steps.

- Coordinate with clinics, pathology labs, sequencing partners and couriers on sample collection, shipping and results.

- Handle sensitive conversations about risks, costs, billing and financial assistance with compassion and discretion. Escalate clinical questions to the medical team.

- Build clear patient trackers and confidential records, and help shape the team's patient-management process.

What we're looking for

- Roughly 2-7 years in patient services, case management, care coordination, nurse navigation or clinical-trial patient support. Strong candidates with less experience will also be considered.

- Direct experience handling difficult conversations with patients, families or clients. This is not a purely back-office coordination role.

- A record of managing complex, time-sensitive logistics across multiple teams and outside partners.

- Clear communication, sound judgment and careful handling of confidential information.

- Ability to work hybrid in San Francisco and take occasional short work trips.

Nice to have

- Oncology knowledge or a nursing, medical or nurse-navigation background.

- Familiarity with HIPAA, Good Clinical Practice, specimen chain of custody or expanded-access programs.

- Experience with personalized or autologous therapies, patient CRM or case-management systems.

- Experience building patient-support processes from scratch.

Pay, visa and travel

- $100,000-$130,000 base salary, plus equity.

- Visa transfers and new visa sponsorship are open for consideration.

- Occasional short trips to support patient dosing, with work travel paid by the company.

- A founding-team role with room to grow into training and managing other case managers.

Pay: $100.00 - $130.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in South San Francisco, CA 94080

new_jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success & Account Manager (AEO)
new_jobs.description:
**About Conductor:**

Conductor is the leading enterprise AEO platform. Today’s top enterprise brands use Conductor to grow authority and visibility in both AI and traditional search engines. From tracking visibility in LLMs to real-time monitoring of technical site health and scaled AI content creation, Conductor provides a single source of truth that fuels digital growth—all from one platform.

Conductor is a mission-driven company with a commitment to innovation, customer success, and culture. For Conductor, success is improving the lives of everyone in our orbit—our customers, our customers' customers, our employee-owners, and our communities.

**We are open to NYC, SF or Denver based candidates.**

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a high-impact **AEO Program Manager** to act as the primary strategic and operational advisor for our enterprise customers. Combining executive account management and deep strategic platform enablement, this hybrid role bridges commercial vision with hands-on value delivery. You will own the holistic customer partnership—aligning organic marketing goals with Conductor’s AEO solutions, driving platform adoption, uncovering expansion opportunities, and ensuring exceptional executive outcomes.

**What You'll Do (Responsibilities)**
-------------------------------------

* **Account Ownership & Strategic Alignment:** Act as the primary business and technical owner of assigned enterprise accounts. Define and implement clear account business plans that align customer strategic objectives with Conductor's platform capabilities.
* **Executive Relationship Building:** Cultivate trusted, long-term relationships with C-level executives, marketing leaders, and key sponsors. Conduct structured business reviews (QBRs/EBRs)
* **Expansion & Opportunity Identification:** Leverage deep understanding of customer business strategy to identify new business opportunities, expansion paths, and platform upgrades in partnership with Sales and Pre-Sales.
* **Platform Enablement & Adoption:** Serve as the primary subject matter expert on Conductor’s AEO features, leading strategic onboarding, user enablement, standard methodology training, and driving platform adoption across enterprise teams.
* **Cross-Functional Advocacy:** Champion client needs internally, collaborating seamlessly with Dedicated Renewal Specialists, Professional Services, Solutions Consulting, and Product teams to resolve complex challenges and maintain exceptional customer satisfaction.
* **Data Storytelling & Reporting:** Construct compelling reports and customized dashboards to find the “story” in data, directly tying AEO and technical SEO performance to tangible business impact and ROI.
* **Risk Mitigation & Health Management:** Proactively monitor account health metrics, platform utilization trends, and operational risks to ensure long-term account vitality and value realization.

**Who You Are (Required Skills/Abilities)**
-------------------------------------------

* **Experience:** **6 to 8+ years o**f experience in Enterprise Account Management, Customer Success, or Strategic Consulting within a B2B SaaS environment.
* **Domain Knowledge:** Deep proficiency in Digital Marketing, with hands-on expertise or strong familiarity in SEO, AEO, content strategy, and web/IT infrastructure.
* **Executive Presence:** Proven track record of consulting directly with C-suite executives and IT/procurement stakeholders, conveying complex technical concepts clearly and persuasively.
* **Tech & Systems Fluency:** Strong proficiency in Salesforce and enterprise analytics platforms. Comfortable navigating web-based technical conversations.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Adept at account planning, discovery, value-mapping, and identifying account expansion opportunities (while leaving renewal mechanics to specialists).
* **Education & Travel:** BA/BS degree or equivalent experience. Willingness to travel (10%+) for on-site client business reviews and adoption workshops.

The future of work is transformed at Conductor, and we don’t just use AI - we weave it into everything we do. We prioritize hiring individuals who stay ahead of the curve, seeking "AI leading" talent who are curious, adaptable, and skilled at utilizing AI to amplify their specific roles. Because we are committed to this tech-forward environment, every candidate’s journey includes a dedicated assessment of their AI literacy and competency by a specialized panel of experts to ensure you are ready to thrive and lead at Conductor.

**Compensation**: Conductor maintains competitive, performance-based compensation programs.

The **base salary range** for this role is **currently $90,000-105,000/year. Variable compensation:** In addition to the base salary, this role is also eligible for a variable bonus based on attainment of quota and performance targets. **This operates a 70/30 split.** With full achievement of your quota, your **On-Target Earnings (OTE)** can range from **$120,000-150,000 annually.**

Actual base salary offered may vary within this range based on education, knowledge, skills, abilities, relevant experience, internal equity, and geographic location, among other factors. The actual compensation, if offered a position, will be based on these factors.

Conductor LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Bringing in diverse perspectives and challenging our assumptions is the clear key to growth; it drives innovation, creativity, faster problem-solving, and stronger decision making. All aspects of employment including the decision to hire, promote, train, discipline, or discharge, will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs*.*

Conductor does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, mental or physical disability, medical condition, genetic inform

**Account Manager – Client Partnerships & Liquidity Solutions**

**Location:** San Francisco, California 94102 (Downtown / Financial District)  
**Position Type:** Full-time, permanent, benefits-eligible (at-will employment)  
**Work Arrangement:** Hybrid – flexible mix of in-office and remote work  
**Compensation:** $6,500 – $8,700 gross per month (approximately $78,000 – $104,400 annually) + annual performance-based bonus (up to 15%)  
**Work Authorization:** Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without requiring sponsorship

**Why This Role Stands Out**

This is not a typical account management position. You will be joining a specialized consulting firm where liquidity management, treasury advisory, and working capital optimization are the core of what we do. Our San Francisco office serves a sophisticated client base — industrial corporations, financial institutions, and investment funds — and we need someone who can grow into a trusted partner for those clients.

You will report to a Senior Account Manager and work alongside teams in Financial Consulting, Treasury Advisory, Compliance, Data Analytics, and Customer Success. If you are early in your career, hungry to learn, and want exposure to high-level financial consulting, this is the environment where that happens.

**What You'll Be Doing**

**Client Portfolio Coordination**  
Support the Senior Account Manager in overseeing a portfolio of domestic and international clients. Manage operational tasks, administrative workflows, and routine reporting to keep accounts running efficiently.

**Client-Facing Communication**  
Serve as the first point of contact for client inquiries regarding liquidity management services — cash forecasting, working capital optimization, cash flow management, and treasury operations. Ensure every response is timely, professional, and accurate.

**Consulting Project Support**  
Collaborate with senior consultants to gather and analyze client financial data. Assist with preparing reports, executive presentations, and commercial proposals. Track project milestones and flag issues that need escalation.

**New Client Onboarding**  
Guide new clients through the early stages of the relationship. Provide clear information about our services, collect required documentation, and help coordinate a smooth project kickoff.

**Reporting & Analysis**  
Prepare periodic reports on portfolio performance, project KPIs, liquidity metrics, and client satisfaction using CRM tools and advanced spreadsheets.

**Contributing to Team Goals**  
Support retention targets, customer satisfaction (CSAT) goals, upselling objectives, and overall portfolio growth.

**Who We're Looking ForEducation & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Industrial Engineering, Political Science, or a related field.
* 0–2 years of professional experience in account management, customer success, commercial support, administrative coordination, or analytical roles. Relevant internship experience in consulting, corporate finance, treasury, or private banking is highly valued.
* Exposure to consulting firms, professional services, banking, fintech, treasury departments, or financial sector organizations is beneficial.

**Technical Competencies**

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel for financial data analysis and reporting.
* Familiarity with CRM systems such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
* Ability to produce professional documents — reports, presentations, and client proposals.
* Basic understanding of liquidity management concepts (cash flow, working capital, treasury, banking relationships) is a strong advantage.

**Language Skills**

Proficiency in additional languages is highly welcomed and will be considered a valuable asset. Our firm serves international clients and operates with global consulting methodologies, so the ability to communicate in languages such as Italian, Spanish, French, or German will support your work with cross-border clients and international projects. English fluency is required for all internal and client-facing communication.

**Personal Attributes**

* Strong interpersonal and communication abilities, with a focus on active listening and empathy.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Proactive and intellectually curious, with a genuine desire to learn and grow.
* Effective problem-solver who can translate complex client needs into actionable steps.
* Collaborative team player who adapts well to a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

**Compensation & Benefits**

We believe that exceptional work deserves exceptional rewards. Our compensation philosophy is built on transparency, performance, and long-term partnership.

* **Base Salary:** $6,500 – $8,700 gross per month, aligned with experience and qualifications.
* **Performance Bonus:** Annual MBO bonus of up to 15%, determined by individual and team results.
* **Health Coverage:** Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* **Retirement:** 401(k) plan with employer contributions.
* **Paid Time Off:** Generous PTO policy plus company holidays.
* **Commuter Assistance:** Parking allowance, transit reimbursement, or commuter benefits.
* **Work-Life Balance:** Hybrid schedule, flexible working hours, and a supportive, digitally enabled work culture.
* **Professional Development:** Structured onboarding, dedicated mentorship from a senior colleague, access to training platforms covering financial consulting, liquidity management, corporate treasury, and soft skills. Individual training budget and support for professional certifications such as CTP (Certified Treasury Professional) or courses in cash management and working capital.
* **Office Perks:** Modern workspace in San Francisco's Financial District featuring coworking areas, relaxation spaces, periodic team-building events, wellness program, gym discounts, and a culture rooted in transpar

===========================================

**Hayward, CA | $80,000 - $95,000 +Annual Bonus Potential**

At **Gothic Landscape**, we are about delivering extraordinary customer service and building authentic relationships—not only with our clients, but with our teams. With ingenuity, vision, and dedication, we transform landscapes into places where people live, work, and play.

As the nation's largest family-owned and operated commercial landscaping company, we never forget why we do what we do—and who makes it all possible. **Our people are the foundation of our success. Together, we create something unique that continues to grow year after year.**

**This position is located in Hayward, CA.**

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in trust and safety, community operations, social/user support escalations, or a related front-line operations role at a consumer or developer platform.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Proven experience in crisis management, brand communications, and serving as a working incident manager.
* Deep understanding of YouTube’s products, policies, creator communities, and brand risk trends.
* Ability to streamline inefficient workflows and translate broad requirements into actionable plans.
* Exceptional communication skills to translate complex topics and influence cross-functional partners.
* Strong pattern-detection using social analytics tools to troubleshoot policies and measure impact.
* Strong bias toward action, prioritizing critically and deciding comfortably within ambiguous landscapes.

**About the job**
-----------------

YouTube’s Social, Community and Escalation Operations team works 24/7 at the forefront of online engagement, managing both public conversations and sensitive user interactions. We are the brand's voice on social and community channels, actively shaping public discourse, fostering community growth, and scaling support. Simultaneously, we protect brand reputation and user safety through direct outreach and expert escalation management for sensitive and security-related issues.

As the Policy Vertical Lead for Social and Escalation Operations, you'll be on the front lines of how YouTube shapes and protects our brand reputation 24/7. In this role, you will lead YouTube’s social operations and escalation management strategy for the policy vertical, covering trust and safety, business generation, and other responsibility enforcement efforts. With your written communication skills, and a bias toward action, you will ensure rapid problem-solving for policy escalations. You will be directly responsible for building and maintaining operational excellence (e.g., workflow design, knowledge management, communication materials, training efforts), and advocating social, community, and escalation insights. You are expected to be the authority on how users will react to new policies and work with cross-functional teams to improve external communications, user journeys, and escalation experiences. As a strategic cross-functional partner, you will play a critical role in preempting and resolving urgent escalations, while shaping our 24x7 global crisis response strategy.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $114000 - $163000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Build deep expertise in YouTube’s guidelines, business generation, and responsibility policies, focusing on enforcement launches and workflows.
* Design, manage, and optimize 24/7 social support and escalation workflows, including knowledge management, communication materials, and design documents.
* Identify operational knowledge gaps and build adaptable training resources to strengthen the team's trust and safety acumen. Lead high-priority incident response for critical policy escalations, guiding managers, advising on external communication, and driving cross-functional resolutions.
